selected_problem: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. Fresh code reality exposed a path-identity defect in federated proposal normalization: safety checks canonicalized candidate paths for validation, but the normalized proposal retained the original path spelling. Equivalent paths such as src/../src/target.mjs and src/target.mjs could therefore evade exact-consensus and same-path conflict accounting even though downstream workspace semantics resolve them to the same file.

decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC/RCL/RNCS success receipt is claimed. The latest canonical evidence still identifies native-complex-changeset-synthesis as unresolved; focused inspection found one narrow, central, evidence-rich semantic-identity defect, so the checked-in DWAC routing contract resolves to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT rather than a forced mode rotation.

code_reality: core/federated-generation.mjs previously used path.posix.normalize only inside a boolean safeRel check, then emitted the original slash-normalized path string.
Consensus fingerprints and same-path conflict maps use the emitted path string as identity.

Workspace path resolution canonicalizes path traversal segments inside the repository, so aliases such as src/../src/target.mjs and src/target.mjs refer to the same file while the federation layer previously treated them as different identities.
Manifest existing-file matching had the same alias mismatch, and needs_more_context retained non-canonical spellings.
asset_reuse: Reused the existing federated selector, ChangeSetIR/preimage semantics, workspace path boundary and DWAC implementation/architecture/verifier candidate federation.
No new model, provider, product form, interface shape or synthesis architecture was introduced.
RCL authority, transactional changesets, validation, rollback and GitHub delivery boundaries remain unchanged.
changes: Proposal change paths are now canonicalized to one repository-relative POSIX identity before fingerprinting, scoring or staging.
Manifest paths are canonicalized through the same identity function before existing-edit scoring.
needs_more_context paths are canonicalized and deduplicated before context recovery.
Equivalent path aliases now contribute exact agreement when their executable semantics match and surface same-file conflicts when their contents or preimage gates differ.
Federated selection receipt protocol advances to taowind.federated-changeset-selection.v0.5.
truth_boundaries: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. Canonical path identity removes one false-consensus/conflict-blindness class; it does not create missing semantic code-generation capability.
Consensus remains ranking evidence rather than proof of correctness. Real validation, rollback and delivery gates remain non-compensatory.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime, RCL and RNCS adapter surfaces returned transient HTTP 502 in this cycle; no hosted success receipt is fabricated.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive external action was performed.
